**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of HYOU1 in cellular stress response and its link to hematologic dysfunction could inform therapeutic strategies for granulocytopenia and immunoglobulin abnormalities. Similarly, DDX11's role in hematopoiesis could offer insights into Disease A.
